add_account_steps.step_1_desc: Click "Save Current" to backup the account you're currently using.
add_account_steps.step_2_desc: Run the command below in Terminal to log out of the current account.
add_account_steps.step_3_desc: Run the "claude" command in Terminal; it will prompt you to log in again.
add_account_steps.step_4_desc: Return to this app and click "Save Current" to save the newly logged-in account.
